author: Jonathan Yantis
time_coordinates: local_us,send_us,receive_us,mid_us relative to native capture start; offset_us relative to first accepted exchange offset; invalid local_us=0 is a sentinel, not a timestamp
validation_policy: first300s NTP rate, prior-fit gate, last16 qualified training PPS fixed base, no later trimming/refit
qualification: Measured GNSS-input phase only; UTC epoch/reference/capture/output uncertainty unqualified

control.remaining_confounds: Fixed >=300s uninterrupted full logging warmup; elapsed boot time, temperature/environment/source/path may vary
